subject: MSA Kickoff: priority lanes, evidence owners, and template selection
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: StellarOps Legal <legal@stellarops.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: MSA Kickoff: priority lanes, evidence owners, and template selection

Folks / StellarOps team —

Thanks for the fast handoff on this new engagement. Attached is the initial order form and the counterparty contact sheet from Sales. We want to run a compact intake so we can set up the MSA + Order Form redline sprint this week. Primary asks below: 

1) Template decision: confirm if the counterparty prefers their order-form-first approach or to adopt Redwood's standard Order Form + Exhibits template. If they want to keep their Order Form, note any mandatory Exhibit structure they require.

2) Priority lanes: please triage clauses we should prioritize for the first redline pass (examples below). We aim to deliver a first-pass redline within 72 hours after alignment.
   - Data residency / hosting
   - SOC 2 / audit obligations
   - Indemnity & liability caps
   - IP / use-of-output clarifications

3) Evidence owners: assign internal owners for the security items (SOC 2 summary, data flow diagram, encryption details) so we can send a consolidated evidence packet.

4) Signer & billing contacts: confirm the signatory scope and billing contact on the Order Form (Sales provided Samir Patel as signer, cc'd on the order form PDF).

Attachments: StellarOps_OrderForm_v1.pdf (order form they sent)

Next steps I propose: Marissa to assemble initial redline checklist + map to our template; Kimberly to own security evidence request; I'll coordinate signatures and timeline with Sales/Finance.

Marissa / Kimberly — can you reply with owners and whether we should keep the StellarOps Order Form or swap to our template?

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Sr. Manager, Commercial Ops — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: StellarOps Legal <legal@stellarops.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MSA Kickoff: priority lanes, evidence owners, and template selection

Jonas — thanks, added a short intake plan below. I took a quick pass on the Order Form and highlighted a few immediate flags. See attachments: Redline-Checklist.xlsx and Exhibit_A_draft.pdf (handy for mapping their service descriptions to our Exhibits).

Quick intake + owners (first pass):
- Template: recommend we keep StellarOps' Order Form for speed but attach our standardized Exhibits A/B/C to capture usage/data terms and SLA language. If legal pushes back on embedded terms, we'll propose a redline that migrates key clauses to Exhibit B (SLA).
- Priority lanes (owner):
  * Data residency / hosting — Kimberly Park (security)
  * SOC2 / audit access — Kimberly Park
  * Liability cap + indemnity — Contracts (me)
  * Termination & transition assistance — Contracts (me)
  * Payment & billing schedule — Finance (I will loop Hana from Finance after this thread)
- Evidence packet (target list): SOC2 summary, encryption-at-rest notes, data flow diagram, subprocessor list. Kimberley — can you confirm if the SOC2 summary in attachments is sufficient or if you need the full report?

Redline cadence: my plan is to do a synchronous first-pass redline and then a 48-hour asynchronous comment period with StellarOps legal. If they accept our proposed Exhibits, we'll have a clean Order Form + Exhibits structure.

Proposed deliverables by EOD tomorrow:
- First-pass redline (tracked) of Order Form and key MSA clauses
- Draft Exhibit A (service descriptions) for customer review
- Evidence request email template for Kimberly to send to their security team

Jonas — I added items to Redline-Checklist.xlsx and linked the drive folder in the sheet (drive link included there).

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Contracts Manager, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: MSA Kickoff: priority lanes, evidence owners, and template selection

Hi Jonas / Marissa —

Thanks for the clear plan. Quick responses from our side: 

- Template: StellarOps legal is fine proceeding with our Order Form + Redwood Exhibits if that reduces churn. If Redwood provides Exhibits A/B (SLA & Data Terms), we can accept those as an appendix.
- Evidence: attaching SOC2_Summary.pdf (we'll upload the full report to a secure drive). Link to our evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cStellarOpsEvidence (I included read-only access for redwood-contracts@redwood.ai).
- Data residency: our primary hosting region is us-east-1; we can accept an Exhibit-level residency commitment for EU data if needed but would prefer to retain design control for our multi-region failover. Can Redwood propose Exhibit language that limits residency guarantees to customer-designated datasets?

Action items:
1) Kimberly — please confirm if the SOC2 summary suffices to proceed or whether you need the full SOC2 report + control mappings.
2) Marissa — once you send the initial redline, we'll review the liability cap and indemnity language first. Those are the likely negotiation items.

I attached SOC2_Summary.pdf and our current vendor subprocessor list to a secure folder (link above). Looking forward to the first-pass redline.

Best,
Maya Singh
Head of Business Ops — StellarOps
